description: Detects the absence of formal vendor risk assessments before engaging third-party service providers. Organizations must conduct comprehensive risk assessments of vendors and third-party service providers that will access, process, store, or transmit sensitive information, including evaluation of their security controls, compliance status, and potential risks to the organization's information assets.
applicability: Healthcare organizations subject to HIPAA Business associates handling PHI Organizations pursuing HITRUST certification Technology vendors in healthcare sector Organizations using cloud services or SaaS applications

metadata.detection_notes: Review HITRUST compliance documentation and controls for VENDOR requirements.
